subject: Vendor intake: schedule kickoff + milestone plan and PO path
messages:
From: Sophie Green <sophie.green@orbit-tech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding — scheduling a kickoff and MAP items

Hi Mina / Marcus / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're excited to get Orbit Tech set up with Redwood. To make the vendor activation efficient, can we schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff next week to align on the Mutual Action Plan (MAP), PO path, and required forms?

What we'd like to cover in that call:
- Confirm Redwood stakeholders and owners for provisioning, billing, and security checks
- Walk through Redwood PO process and estimated timing for first invoice
- Review onboarding checklist / vendor form so we can complete any missing items
- Agree on success criteria and milestone dates for go-live

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 14 May, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 15 May, 14:00–14:45
- Thu 16 May, 09:00–09:45

I've attached our draft onboarding form and W-9 to help speed things up. If you have a MAP template I can populate, please send it over and I'll prefill vendor-side info.

Attachments: Orbit_Onboarding_Form_v0.9.pdf (PDF), Orbit_W9.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Sophie Green
Head of Partnerships, Orbit Tech, Inc.
sophie.green@orbit-tech.com
555-415-0098
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Green <sophie.green@orbit-tech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — scheduling a kickoff and MAP items

Hi Sophie — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for sending over the form. We can do Wed 15 May 14:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite for a 45-minute slot.

Draft agenda (45 min):
1) Introductions & roles (5 min) — confirm who owns billing/PO, security evidence, and deployment owner
2) Procurement path & PO cadence (10 min) — what internal approvals are typical, expected lead times, and billing contact
3) MAP walkthrough (10 min) — I'll share our MAP template and we can assign owners + dates
4) Onboarding checklist & outstanding docs (10 min) — SOC2 scope, data retention, technical contact for integration testing
5) Action items & next milestones (10 min)

Success criteria suggestions to consider: initial production tokens < 100k/month on day 1, signed PO + initial invoice paid, and security questionnaire items delivered within 10 business days. We can refine on the call.

I'm attaching the Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx so you can see our preferred layout.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks — invite incoming.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — scheduling a kickoff and MAP items

Mina — thanks, Wed 15 May 14:00 PT works for us.

I've completed the onboarding form with the vendor-side fields and attached the updated copy. We've also included a short SOW summary in the form so you have a sense of expected volume and billing milestones.

Attachments: Orbit_Onboarding_Form_v0.9_filled.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — scheduling a kickoff and MAP items

Thanks Sophie / Mina — quick procurement notes before the kickoff:
- Typical PO lead time is ~7–10 business days once legal & finance have the SOW and vendor W-9 in our system.
- Invoice cadence: Redwood prefers Net30; if Orbit needs Net45 that's OK but we'll note it as a finance exception and it can affect payment timing.
- Billing contact for finance: please include a named billing email in the form (we'll need contact + remit address).

Pre-call ask: Sophie, can you confirm the remit address and attach any vendor registration docs (W-9 already good). If you have a preferred initial invoice amount or milestone schedule, add that to the MAP under "Billing milestones" so we can route correctly.

I'll join the call to cover the PO path and sign-off owners.

Noted — I added two suggested success metrics to the MAP:
1) Onboarding complete (all docs + access provisioning) within 12 business days of kickoff
2) First billing milestone invoiced and accepted within 30 days of signed PO

Looking forward to Wed.

—Kimberly
Vendor Enablement Lead, Redwood Inference
